description: A full update of a community's comprehensive or general plan: baseline, vision, alternatives, a preferred direction, drafted elements, public review and adoption.
scope_notes: This is a standard-practice starting point — edit to your scope. Rename, delete and add records until the list matches the work your agency actually agreed to do.

Every date is calculated forward from the kickoff date you enter. The offsets are round numbers reflecting how this kind of work is usually sequenced — they are placeholders for a real schedule, not commitments.
It assumes a two-body process — an advisory body that recommends and a governing body that adopts. Where your process differs, rename or delete those milestones rather than working around them.
The required elements, the update interval and the review by outside agencies differ by state and country. Nothing here states a requirement; add the elements and reviews your own law asks for.
This is roughly a two-and-a-half-year sequence. A focused update of one or two elements uses the same order over a much shorter span.

No jurisdiction is assumed. Review periods, required notices, hearings and the body that adopts the work are set where you are; none of them are stated here. Add the records your own process requires.
Nobody is assigned. Applying a template never puts a colleague's name on a deadline — assign the records yourself once the team is settled.

deliverables.title: Work plan and community engagement strategy
deliverables.summary: The schedule for the update and how the community — including the parts of it that do not attend meetings — will be involved.

deliverables.title: Baseline conditions report
deliverables.summary: Population, housing, jobs, land, infrastructure, environment and hazards as they stand, with sources named.

deliverables.title: Issues and vision report
deliverables.summary: What the community says matters, gathered before alternatives are drawn.

deliverables.title: Land use and growth alternatives report
deliverables.summary: Alternative growth and land use patterns with their consequences analysed side by side.

deliverables.title: Preferred alternative and policy framework
deliverables.summary: The direction chosen and the policy structure that will carry it.

deliverables.title: Draft plan elements
deliverables.summary: Each element drafted — land use, mobility, housing, environment, safety, services and any others your plan carries.

deliverables.title: Public review draft plan
deliverables.summary: The complete document, map series and supporting analysis assembled for review.

deliverables.title: Final plan document
deliverables.summary: The draft revised in response to comments, with the comment record attached.

deliverables.title: Implementation program
deliverables.summary: The actions the plan commits to, who is responsible for each, and how progress will be reported.

milestones.title: Update kickoff
milestones.summary: Scope, schedule, committee structure and the engagement strategy confirmed.

milestones.title: First round of community workshops
milestones.summary: The community describes the issues before any alternative exists.

milestones.title: Open house on growth alternatives
milestones.summary: The alternatives shown publicly while the preferred direction is still open.

milestones.title: Advisory body study sessions on the draft
milestones.summary: The recommending body works through the draft elements in public session.

milestones.title: Public review of the draft plan opens
milestones.summary: The complete draft is released for comment.

milestones.title: Advisory body hearing and recommendation
milestones.summary: The recommending body holds its hearing and forwards a recommendation.

milestones.title: Adoption by the governing body
milestones.summary: The governing body adopts the updated plan.
